title: DRE sources
description: dbt-style source declarations: the tables a project reads, with DRE's `profile:` for the connection they live on. In any project YAML file under a top-level `sources:` key (`sources/` is the conventional folder); dbt's `version: 2` is accepted beside it. Use a table in SQL with `{{ source('<source>', '<table>') }}`.

version.description: dbt's file version (`2`); accepted and ignored.

source.description: A source: tables in one schema of one system.

name.description: The source's name, the first argument of `source()`. Unique in the project.

database.description: The database (catalog). Set: `source()` renders `database.schema.table`; unset: `schema.table`. May use Jinja with `var()`, `env_var()`, `run.*` and `target.name`.

schema.description: The schema; the source's name unless set. May use Jinja with `var()`, `env_var()`, `run.*` and `target.name`.

profile.description: DRE's addition: the connection (in `profiles.yml`) the source lives on. A query using the source runs there; it overrides the report's, Set's, folder's and project's default. Unset: the source runs wherever its query runs. May use Jinja with `var()`, `env_var()`, `run.*` and `target.name`.
